verdict.rationale: Apple's public pages do include some concrete numbers — 64GB/273GB/s memory bandwidth, Thunderbolt 5 at 120Gb/s, battery-life hours, display resolutions — but core clock speeds and a quantified AI TOPS figure with disclosed test methodology are absent, replaced by vague marketing comparisons like '2.1x faster than the latest AI PC chip' and adjectives such as 'blazing speed' and 'stunning imagery.' Community commenters explicitly call out the lack of apples-to-apples benchmarking methodology ('Why aren't they benching it against the M3?', 'grasping for a headline'), undermining the spec-sheet-over-marketing claim. Missing for 10: published clock speeds, a disclosed AI TOPS number with test conditions, and transparent same-generation benchmark methodology.
